examples.title: Example 1: Implementing Custom Tab Switching Synchronization
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to use onAnimationStart and onChange to implement synchronized switching between the tab bar and tab content.
The resources used in this example are not located in the src > main > resource directory. Starting from DevEco Studio 6.0.0 Beta2, the resources that are located outside the resources directory are not packaged by default when a project or module is created. To package these resources, go to buildOptions in the module's build-profile.json5 file > resOptions > copyCodeResource, and set enable to true. For details, see the description of resOptions.

examples.title: Example 2: Implementing a Custom Side Tabs
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to create side tabs using vertical and barPosition.
The resources used in this example are not located in the src > main > resource directory. Starting from DevEco Studio 6.0.0 Beta2, the resources that are located outside the resources directory are not packaged by default when a project or module is created. To package these resources, go to buildOptions in the module's build-profile.json5 file > resOptions > copyCodeResource, and set enable to true. For details, see the description of resOptions.

examples.title: Example 3: Implementing Different Styles of Tabs
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to create subtabs, bottom tabs, and side tabs using SubTabBarStyle and BottomTabBarStyle.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Indicator for Subtabs
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the indicator for subtabs using the indicator property in SubTabBarStyle.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting Adaptive Height for Subtab Text
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to achieve adaptive height for subtab text using heightAdaptivePolicy.

examples.title: Example 6: Setting Basic Attributes for Bottom Tabs
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set basic attributes for bottom tabs using padding, verticalAlign, layoutMode, and symmetricExtensible.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting Text and Icon Colors for Subtabs and Bottom Tabs
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to change the text color of subtabs and bottom tabs using unselectedColor and selectedColor in LabelStyle and
how to change the icon color of bottom tabs using unselectedColor and selectedColor in iconStyle.
The resources used in this example are not located in the src > main > resource directory. Starting from DevEco Studio 6.0.0 Beta2, the resources that are located outside the resources directory are not packaged by default when a project or module is created. To package these resources, go to buildOptions in the module's build-profile.json5 file > resOptions > copyCodeResource, and set enable to true. For details, see the description of resOptions.

examples.title: Example 8: Using Symbol Icons for Bottom Tabs
examples.description: This example shows how to use symbols as icons in BottomTabBarStyle.

examples.title: Example 9: Setting TabBar Using ComponentContent
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use ComponentContent to encapsulate component content and set the TabBar. The update API of ComponentContent is used to update the TabBar.

examples.title: Example 10: Preloading Child Nodes Using ComponentContent
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use ComponentContent to set the TabBar and preload child nodes using the preloadItems API of TabsController.

examples.title: Example 11: Setting the Indicator of a Subtab to an Image
examples.description: Since API version 22, this example uses the indicator attribute in SubTabBarStyle to implement the subtab indicator in image format.
